## Highlights
### New
- See version details, recent changes, software updates, community feedback, issue reporting, and the public roadmap in About settings
### Fixed
- Keep Mac window controls and collapsed-sidebar reveal available in fullscreen - Restore back and forward history with archived tabs, and keep extension actions and blocking pages attached to the intended tab and destination
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.
